description: The 2016 Ford F-150 XLT stands out as a high-value crew cab pickup, offering a comprehensive standard feature set that often costs extra on competing trucks.  Analytical buyers who research specifications and compare feature lists will appreciate how this truck addresses practical work and family needs. The F-150 XLT's standard equipment-such as split folding rear seats for flexible cargo, power windows, and air conditioning-translates to daily convenience, while its 4WD system is well-suited for unpredictable weather, from Midwestern winters to job site demands. For owners in the St. Louis area who juggle commuting, hauling, and recreational tasks, this truck's blend of capability and comfort offers measurable value per dollar.  Under the hood, this F-150 XLT comes equipped with Ford's proven 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic electronic transmission, delivering a reliable powertrain at a cost that typically undercuts V8 rivals. The 4WD drivetrain provides traction for off-road or adverse weather conditions, all while maintaining EPA estimates of 16 mpg city and 22 mpg highway-a practical balance for truck buyers who want respectable fuel savings over time. Maintenance costs are further kept in check by the widespread availability and affordability of Ford parts, helping owners reduce total cost of ownership.  This truck provides substantial safety value by including a suite of standard features that competitors often reserve for higher trims. Drivers benefit from ABS brakes, dual front and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, and a tire pressure monitoring system-all included without extra charges. The addition of brake assist and a rear step bumper further enhances accident avoidance and utility, making the F-150 XLT a compelling choice for buyers who prioritize standard safety equipment and want peace of mind without costly add-ons.  Standard features on this model extend beyond the basics with amenities like steering wheel mounted audio controls, speed control, a security system, and fully automatic headlights. The audio system includes six speakers and a radio data system for daily entertainment and connectivity. Split folding rear seats enhance cargo flexibility, while power door mirrors and variably intermittent wipers improve ease of use in changing conditions. Owners also benefit from thoughtful design elements such as a front center armrest with storage and illuminated entry, making every drive more convenient.  When comparing value, the F-150 XLT consistently holds its own against rivals like the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT and Ram 1500 Big Horn. While those competitors often require package upgrades for features like keyless entry or advanced safety systems, this truck delivers them as standard.  What's included as standard equipment? The F-150 XLT comes with 4WD, a 3.5L V6 engine, alloy wheels, AM/FM stereo with CD player, air conditioning, and keyless entry, among other features. Is this truck worth the price? Given its comprehensive standard equipment and strong reputation, it represents a smart investment for value-focused buyers. Finished in distinctive Storm Cloud with a refined Black SofTex-trimmed interior, this Grand Highlander delivers an upscale presence with the practicality busy lifestyles demand. With 60,849 miles, it offers an appealing combination of passenger space, intuitive technology, and thoughtful convenience features. Offered by Patterson Autos, this Toyota is ready for everything from daily Orange County commutes and school drop-offs to memorable family road trips.  Under the hood, a responsive 2.4-liter four-cylinder engine pairs with a smooth 8-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive for comfortable, confident everyday performance. Whether navigating city traffic, cruising Southern California freeways, or heading out for a weekend getaway, the Grand Highlander delivers a composed driving experience. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensitive steering contribute to its balanced road manners, while the elevated driving position provides a reassuring perspective of the road ahead. Its spacious design makes traveling with family and friends feel refreshingly effortless.  Inside, the XLE cabin welcomes everyone with comfortable Black SofTex seating and a thoughtfully arranged interior. Heated front seats provide welcome warmth on cooler mornings, while power-adjustable front seats help make longer journeys more relaxing. Dual-zone automatic climate control allows front occupants to personalize their comfort, and rear air conditioning helps keep passengers comfortable throughout the cabin. The second-row seating area and reclining third-row bench provide flexibility for growing families, visiting friends, or extra passengers. Split-folding rear seats make it easy to transition between carrying people and accommodating luggage, groceries, or weekend gear.  Technology adds convenience to every mile with Toyota's impressive 12.3-inch multimedia touchscreen, creating an intuitive hub for entertainment and connectivity. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto make accessing compatible smartphone apps, music, and messages simple, while the six-speaker audio system provides an enjoyable soundtrack for your travels. Toyota's Drive Connect cloud navigation capability offers additional guidance when available through an eligible subscription. Steering-wheel-mounted audio controls, remote keyless entry, and HomeLink help streamline everyday routines, while the power liftgate makes loading and unloading more convenient.  Confidence comes naturally with active cruise control to help make highway travel more relaxing, automatic high-beam headlights for changing nighttime conditions, and a rearview camera that simplifies backing into parking spaces. Electronic stability control, traction control, anti-lock brakes, and multiple airbags provide additional reassurance. Toyota's Safety Connect emergency communication capability adds another thoughtful layer of support, subject to service availability. Stylish 18-inch aluminum alloy wheels, a sleek rear spoiler, and the distinctive Storm Cloud finish complete an SUV that looks as sophisticated as it feels.  Practicality is where the Grand Highlander truly shines.
